gloss: to take (with one); to carry away; to bring along

definitions.gloss: to take (with one); to carry away; to bring along
definitions.explanation: To take an object away from the speaker's location to somewhere else. Compound of {持|も}つ (to hold) + {行|い}く (to go). Used when the destination is away from the speaker; contrasts with {持|も}ってくる (to bring here).

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}っていく。
⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→お弁当：02864_obentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}っていきました。
examples.english: I took a packed lunch to school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}っていく⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詰|つ}めた→詰める：02078_tsumeru⟧。
examples.english: I packed the luggage I'm taking on the trip into a suitcase.

notes:
Transitive godan verb conjugating like ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: {持|も}っていく・{持|も}っていって・{持|も}っていった. Often written ⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧; the hiragana form もっていく is also common in casual writing. Pairs with ⟦{持|も}ってくる→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧ for direction.

TRANSITIVITY:
Marks the object with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ and the destination with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧.
- ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}っていく: to take a souvenir home

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}っていく: to take an umbrella
- ⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持|も}っていく: to bring lunch
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{持|も}っていく: to remember to take

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{持|も}ってくる→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧: to bring here — direction toward the speaker
- ⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to carry; transport — focuses on the act of conveying, not direction relative to speaker
